verdict: Bounded additive intake (issue #349), continuing the 2026-10-06/2026-10-07 dossier series. No new literature search was performed; this pass extracts exactly one previously-identified-but-unextracted figure from an already-cached, already-hashed primary source (Abdelaal et al. 2019 Additional File 1, Figure S10 Panel B), re-rendered at page-image resolution and read directly (not OCR, not color inference, not pdftotext). Ingests the SVMrejection row only (9 values): a conventional rejection-option baseline across the paper's genuine inter-dataset (cross-dataset, cross-species where applicable) brain annotation-transfer design (VISp/ALM/MTG, 34-population annotation level). VISp and ALM share GSE115746. MTG is a separate human single-nucleus dataset; combinations involving MTG include cross-species data. Some two-dataset training combinations still share the mouse study with the test dataset, so independent-study holdout must not be inferred for all nine combinations. This is a deliberately narrow, coherent subset of the 18-classifier heatmap shown in the source figure, not a full-panel ingestion; the other 17 classifier rows, Figure S10 Panel A (3-population level), and Figure S9 (PBMC) are explicitly not ingested. Reuses the existing SVMrejection method/configuration records (ucc-research-method-abdelaal-svm-linear, ucc-research-config-abdelaal-svm-rejection) by reference, unmodified, since this is the identical classifier identity already catalogued for the Baron Human intra-dataset evaluation. Adds one new source record for the supplement PDF specifically (a separate byte artifact, SHA-256 797a2b22f584135f4ff6f7c98203d8e9529d6600f675b500205607b47b212a81, from the already-catalogued main-text XML). No model execution, no superiority claim across methods, and no unknown/absent-type-detection accuracy claim: this is a coverage/rejection-rate baseline only.
gaps: The scored denominator (exact number of cells scored in each individual train-test experiment) is unreported in the retrieved main text and supplement. Table 2's raw per-dataset cell counts (VISp 12,832; ALM 8,758; MTG 14,636) are recorded as context only on the linked dataset records, not as a confirmed denominator.
Only the SVMrejection row is ingested; the other 17 classifiers in the same Figure S10 Panel B heatmap, and the entire Figure S10 Panel A (3-population level), remain unextracted.

Figure S9 Panel A (PBMC cross-protocol heatmap) carries no printed digit labels in the source PDF at any resolution checked, and separately shows an unresolved source-internal conflict between its own caption ("median F1-score"), the page's only legend ("Unlabeled (%)"), and the figure's overall title ("Percentage of unlabeled cells"); nothing from it is ingested.

This remains a pre-2019 conventional-classifier result; it does not include scTab, CellTypist, Azimuth, scANVI, or scParadise, and does not by itself answer the use case's compound known-type-accuracy-and-unknown-type-rejection-at-matched-coverage-across-independent-studies question.
Automated source review only; independent human scientific review remains outstanding.
This bounded ingestion is separate from, and does not measure or substitute for, the common-protocol cross-study benchmark gap tracked at rewire-benchmarks #27.

suggested_mappings.endpoint: Inter-dataset (cross-dataset, cross-species where applicable) SVMrejection conventional rejection-option baseline: percentage of test-set cells left unlabeled across all 9 VISp/ALM/MTG train-test combinations, 34-cell-population annotation level.
suggested_mappings.rationale: A conventional-classifier rejection-option baseline on a genuine cross-dataset brain annotation-transfer design (cross-study and cross-species for the 7 of 9 combinations involving MTG; VISp and ALM are two mouse datasets from the same source study GSE115746, so independent-study holdout is not established for every pair), directly relevant to the use case's 'identify cells that require expert review' endpoint, but a single pre-2019 classifier's coverage/rejection rate only, not a known-type accuracy or unknown-type-detection accuracy result, and not a comparison against scTab/CellTypist/Azimuth/scANVI/scParadise.
constraints: Inter-dataset (whole-dataset train/test combinations across VISp, ALM, MTG), not a within-dataset cross-validation split.
34-cell-population (deeper) annotation level only; the 3-population major-lineage level (Figure S10 Panel A) is not included.
SVMrejection only; the other 17 classifiers shown in the same source figure are not included.
limitations: Scored denominator is unreported; Table 2's raw per-dataset cell counts are context only, not a confirmed denominator.
metric_direction is "unknown" for every result: percentage unlabeled is a coverage/rejection-rate figure, not a standalone performance metric with one universal direction.
Not a known-type accuracy claim, not an unknown/absent-type-detection accuracy claim, and not a superiority claim over any other classifier.
Reference labels are the original brain-atlas studies' author annotations, not independently adjudicated ground truth.
Automated source review only; independent human scientific review remains outstanding.
Predates scTab, CellTypist, Azimuth, scANVI and scParadise; does not evaluate them.
